source.access: Read 11.10.2026 through web search result snippets of publications.blum.com pages only. The container proxy refuses publications.blum.com, d2.blum.com, e-services.blum.com, blum.com and every dealer host (CONNECT tunnel 403) and the WebFetch tool resolved no host at all (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, example.com included), so no page and no PDF was opened. Every catalogue number below is what a search snippet of the named page printed, with the page number the snippet carried; a table whose cells the snippet garbled is null with a sentence beside it. Dealer numbers are listed as such, by dealer id, and are not the catalogue.

source.caveat: A value with status owner to confirm is Blum's or a dealer's as the snippet printed it; a null value is NOT in any source this agent could read and the note says where it lives. Nothing here is invented. The hinge angle stays derived (T22 law): a family is chosen, the angle inside the family comes off the front thickness.

standard.label: CLIP top BLUMOTION 110 / 95 by front thickness (today's rule)

wide.label: wide-angle: CLIP top 170 up to the thickness Blum needs no gap for, CLIP top BLUMOTION 155 0-protrusion above it
wide.rationale: T78 proposed, owner to confirm. The owner asked for the widest opening (180 stopni); 170 is the widest Blum publishes. Catalogue p. 89: the 170 needs no gap F up to FD 21 and a trial application above 22, so the rung stops at 21. Catalogue p. 84/85 and dealers D01/D03/D05: the 155 0-protrusion covers fronts to 24, so it takes 22 to 24. Above 24 the family has no rung and hingeAngleFor answers null (the BOM prints the spec, no article). Alternatives the owner may prefer: 170 everywhere to 24 with the trial note, or 155 everywhere (soft close integrated).

cup_pattern.repo_drilling_distance_note: profile.hinges.cups.xFromHingeEdge 21.5 minus the cup radius 17.5 = TB 4, inside every family's TB range below (3 to 7 standard, 3 to 8 wide by the dealers; the catalogue planning tables are null here)
cup_pattern.repo_cup_depth_note: profile.hardware.hinge.cupDepth 11 and layer FRONT_HINGES_35MM depth 11 (profile.js). Dealers give 13 for the 110 and 95 (D13, D15; the Blum US brochure D14 says every 35 hole a minimum of 13 deep), 11.7 for the 155 (D01), 11 for the 170 (D06, D07) and 11 or 13.5 for the bi-fold (D21 vs D20). Not moved by this file; the owner decides.
